messages:
Sarah (Sales): AcmeCorp just emailed — they want a 4-week POC. Requirements: 500 req/s steady, median token latency <60ms, CMKs with HSM-backed signing, quarterly rotation test, and an audit log for every decrypt. Can we commit?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Love it. Quick Q: do they insist on network-proxied KMS (edge) or will cloud HSM suffice for POC?
Jordan (AcmeCorp): for POC cloud HSM is fine as long as keys are customer-managed and we can trigger rotation. We'll need an attestation doc for HSM used.
Marta (CryptoOps): OK. We support BYO-CMK with AWS CloudHSM/KMS wrap or our managed CMK with HSM attest. Need to confirm: do they require split custody or just single-custody CMK?
Jordan (AcmeCorp): Single custody for now. We'll evaluate split custody later.
Evan (SRE): Major blocker: KMS latency in the critical path can spike token latency. For 500 rps we need to ensure prefetch/KV cache warms and that signature ops are async. What's the current path in POC config?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): POC config uses prefix KV caching + background refresh; decrypts only at first request for a session. We can enable local ephemeral wrapping keys to avoid per-token KMS calls. That should keep median <60ms.
Sarah (Sales): Pricing question from Acme: will we bill KMS calls separately or include in the POC allowance? They want predictable cost.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): For POC we typically include reasonable KMS call budget (up to X/month) in the trial. After POC, KMS calls billed pass-through plus a small service surcharge if they use our managed CMK. I'll put numbers in the proposal.
Marta (CryptoOps): Need to flag compliance: customer asked for rotation dry-run where they trigger rotation and we prove zero downtime. That requires an automated rotation test and both old/new key acceptance in signing. We currently support staged rotation: dual-wrap acceptance window. Ops needs to exercise this in staging.
Evan (SRE): I'll run a failover + rotation chaos test in staging. Need a runbook step list. Also need a firewall whitelist from Acme for our staging IPs.
Jordan (AcmeCorp): sending whitelists now. Also: security questionnaire Q12 asks about HSM attestation frequency and key ceremony. Can you provide a short paragraph about how Redwood handles attestations?
Marta (CryptoOps): Draft: "Redwood supports HSM-backed key material with FIPS-validated HSMs. Attestations available on request; key ceremonies are documented and can be scheduled with customer observers. For POC, we provide HSM attestation report and cryptographic proof-of-possession for CMKs." Copy/paste that for the questionnaire?
Jordan (AcmeCorp): perfect.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) Evan to run staging throughput test w/ rotation dry-run (ETA 3 days). 2) Marta to produce attestation paragraph + rotation runbook (ETA 48h). 3) Sales to confirm billing line for KMS calls in POC SOW. 4) Solutions to prepare small load script and instructions for Acme.
Evan (SRE): I'll kick off a synthetic load run: command below (for internal use):
```bash
# sim load: 500 rps, 30s ramp, check p50/p95
./rload --target https://staging.api.redwood.ai/predict --concurrency 200 --rate 500 --duration 300
```
Evan (SRE): Note: enable --prefetch-kv and --ephemeral-wrap flags in staging config to mirror POC.
Marta (CryptoOps): For the rotation dry-run we'll do: 1) create new CMK alias, 2) dual-wrap window enabled, 3) route 10% traffic to new key, 4) validate signatures and logs, 5) finalize cutover. Will document in runbook.
Sarah (Sales): Jordan — after runbook and a brief staging test we'll offer a 2-week dedicated POC window with an escrow of X credits, includes N KMS calls. We need them to sign an NDA addendum for attestation.
Jordan (AcmeCorp): NDA addendum signed and returned. Whitelist attached. Ready for your staging IPs.
Evan (SRE): deploy-bot: start staging environment for acme-poc (region: us-west-2)
deploy-bot: staging cluster acme-poc-usw2 created, pods 12/12, ready
Evan (SRE): Running first smoke test now, will post results.
Evan (SRE): smoke results: p50=44ms, p95=98ms with default config (no ephemeral wrap). With prefetch+ephemeral-wrap expect p95 ~70ms.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Good. I'll prep a short doc for Acme on how to trigger rotation and what metrics to watch.
Marta (CryptoOps): I'll attach the attestation snippet to the questionnaire and share the runbook.
Sarah (Sales): Great — once Evan posts the throughput run I'll schedule the kickoff call. Thanks all.
Jordan (AcmeCorp): Thanks team, excited to get this started.
Sarah (Sales): Next steps recap in thread: Evan test + logs (3d), Marta attestation + runbook (48h), Ravi pricing SOW line (EOD)"
